verdict.rationale: Sumsub's docs explicitly describe Liveness & Face match checks that confirm the applicant is a real, live person and match them to documents, with named defenses against deepfakes, AI-generated images, paper masks, and photos of screens, plus dashboard review of liveness results. missing for 10: no independent/third-party lab test results (e.g., iBeta/NIST PAD certification) or hands-on failure/success reports corroborating the anti-spoofing claims.
